name: Thaumaturgy (Path of Transmutation) — 2 Intermediate — Liquefy the Solid Form

system.description: The thaumaturge melts an object into a liquid puddle by spending a number of Mental Traits relative to its size (a stake might cost one, a tank seven or eight). This power does not affect living or unliving beings. At the end of the scene, the puddle reforms into its original shape using whatever material remains, unless it has been scattered. This path retests with the Occult Ability and functions upon any object within the thaumaturge's direct line of sight, though blood within a living body cannot be affected.
